set.reason: The criterion expressly permits rectangle partitions as an alternative to triangle partitions. Retain each route conditionally rather than conjoin the area formulas for every figure. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: Calculating rectangular pieces in a rectangular partition of a composite area

set.reason: The criterion explicitly permits triangles OR rectangles. Both external reviews turn that alternative into an unconditional requirement, but an L-shaped orthogonal figure can be split entirely into rectangles. Preserve triangle area as a component of the triangular-piece route without making every composite-area task use it.
set.scope: Calculating triangular pieces in a triangular partition of a composite area

set.reason: The broad description allows partition into studied shapes, so a trapezoid partition is a useful optional method. The explicit triangle/rectangle criterion and rectangle-only examples show it is not universally required.
set.scope: Calculating trapezoid pieces when a composite figure is partitioned into familiar trapezoids
